title: Streetcar Physical Track Date Data
scope: PhysicalSegment geometry only. The dates estimate historic passenger use on one or more scoped portions, not track construction or removal.
persistent_caveat: Proposed outer-year envelope; does not establish uninterrupted service.
temporal_boundary_convention: Annual integer filter: start_year <= selected_year <= end_year. Both endpoint years are included. This is a display convention, not a claim of full-year, uninterrupted or whole-segment use.
publication_status: User-authorized public research preview. No third-party source license or dataset reuse license is asserted.

provenance.binding: Joined only by segment_id to PhysicalSegment.id and ResearchGeometry.segment_id; required identical working_geometry_hash and exact geometry. Current M6 labels preserved. fid is a display/reference field, not a join key.
provenance.review_scope: Recovery and structural verification of supplied files only. Historical sources were not independently re-opened for this demo; no confidence was upgraded.
provenance.geometry_sha256_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted, no spaces, ensure_ascii=False. Geometry coordinates are preserved exactly.

crs.name: WGS 84
crs.geojson_standard: RFC 7946; no legacy crs member emitted

file_contract.segments.geojson: 269 physical geometries with current M6 names and proposed annual envelope fields
file_contract.evidence.json: Curated public per-segment rationale, scoped-history summaries, claim IDs and citation warnings; no embedded original source payloads
file_contract.source_registry.json: All 193 source records, indexed by source ID; unsafe/incomplete links omitted with explicit status
file_contract.field_dictionary.json: Exact field definitions, temporal convention and unchanged-evidence semantics

source_link_review: No live link checking performed. Four source URLs with token parameters withheld, two incomplete URLs omitted, four absent URLs retained as null.
temporal_special_cases: Best-year slider range is 1862–1962. These are not installation/removal years.
Do not substitute the expanded uncertainty envelope start_earliest_year through end_latest_year for the best-year filter without an explicit separate mode.
FIDs 252 and 253 have start_latest_year 1920 after end_earliest_year 1910. Endpoint ranges do not define a certain operating core.
FIDs 237 and 238 retain an estimated opening date 1923-12-02 with day precision. It is not a verified date. All verified endpoint fields remain null.

Known-period records exist for 179 segments. They contain heterogeneous interruptions, contextual histories and scenarios. They are preserved as evidence, not normalized or subtracted from the year filter.
Fourteen explicit mixed-subextent flags are a lower bound on mixed-history cautions; additional prose may describe mixed scope.
A zero-width endpoint range does not mean the endpoint is verified.
public_evidence_policy: Public assets contain supplied geometry, proposed factual years, editorial rationale/cautions, scoped history summaries, source bibliography/URLs, and claim IDs. Full historical-source payloads, long quotations, original ledger and internal inspection notes are excluded.
public_release_source: Built from unchanged validated 269-feature data handoff dated 2026-10-09. Geometry and feature properties preserved byte-for-byte.
